# 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum)

Generated by `npm run build` from the feature files in `src/components/` and the step definitions in `src/tests/_shared-steps/`. Edit those, not this file.

Level AA. [Understanding 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum) on w3.org](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/target-size-minimum.html).

Scenarios: automatic.

## Setup

- [`Given I load the sample "<input-url>"`](../../../src/tests/_shared-steps/1-Given/samples-load.js) — Loads a sample to test from a web URL.
- [`When I view the rendered "<selector>"`](../../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/elements-are-viewed.js) — Checks an element is visibly rendered on the page.
- [`When I click on "<selector>"`](../../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/mouse-events-occur.js) — Clicks an element with the primary mouse button

## Assertions

- [`Then it should have a width and height of at least 24px`](../../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/visual-checks.js) — Automatically checks an element has a target size of at least 24px. Note: Could cause false positives if used on things like inline links.

## Example

```gherkin
Background:
  Given I load the sample "http://localhost:8081/accordion/examples/default"

@2.5.8 @aa @automatic
Rule: 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum), Level AA
  Scenario Outline: The triggers and the Show all sections button have a target area size of at least 24 by 24 pixels
    When I view the rendered "<element>"
    Then it should have a width and height of at least 24px
    Examples:
      | element                                         |
      | .tl-accordion__toggle-all                       |
      | .tl-accordion__section:nth-of-type(1) > button |
```
